description: This file is a JSON schema defining the interface for the MaintenanceManager plugin, including methods, events, and data structures related to maintenance activities on set-top devices.

methods.name: getMaintenanceActivityStatus
methods.description: Gets the maintenance activity status details, including current maintenance status, last success time, criticality, reboot requirement, and success indicator.

methods.name: getMaintenanceStartTime
methods.description: Retrieves the scheduled maintenance start time.

methods.name: setMaintenanceMode
methods.description: Sets the maintenance mode and software upgrade opt-out mode.

methods.name: getMaintenanceMode
methods.description: Retrieves the current maintenance mode and software upgrade opt-out settings.
